Welcome to Upstream Rehabilitation’s official YouTube channel — your trusted resource for injury recovery, physical rehabilitation, and career guidance.

We’re here to support patients through every step of their treatment journey—alongside the physical therapists and occupational therapists who help them thrive. As the largest dedicated outpatient physical therapy provider in the U.S., we’re committed to delivering quality, clinical care and empowering our community through evidence-based education and real patient stories.

What you’ll find on our channel:
Clinical tips and rehabilitation techniques from experienced providers
Real patient success stories from across our national care network
Career development guidance for physical therapy professionals
The latest in physical therapy innovation, technology, and integrated care
At Upstream, our mission is to inspire and empower the lives we touch, serve our communities, and lead with purpose-driven passion.

Learn more at urpt.com
